# general QC

## QC plots

```{r}
QC_summary <- Sys.glob("output/*/QC/*_summary.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(., select = c("sequence_length_template", "mean_qscore_template")) %>%
            mutate(Sample = gsub("_summary.tsv", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  group_by(Sample)


# read length            
QC_summary %>%
ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = sequence_length_template, fill = Sample))+
  geom_violin()+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA)+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = log10_trans(),labels = label_comma(), name = "Read Length")+
  xlab("Cell Line")+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_line_palette )+
  theme(legend.position= "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))

ggsave("plots/QC/read_length.pdf",width = 8, height =7 )

# mean qscore
QC_summary %>%
ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = mean_qscore_template, fill = Sample))+
  geom_violin(adjust = 4)+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA)+
  scale_y_continuous( name = "Mean Quality Score per Read")+
  xlab("Cell Line")+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_line_palette )+
  theme(legend.position= "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))

ggsave("plots/QC/mean_base_quality.pdf",width = 8, height =7 )
  

#coverage
Coverage <- Sys.glob("output/*/coverage/*.summary.txt")%>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(., select = c("chrom", "mean")) %>%
            mutate(Sample = gsub("_unphased.mosdepth.summary.txt", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, levels = c(paste0("chr", seq(0, 22))))) %>%
  filter(! is.na(chrom))

Coverage %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chrom, y = mean, group = Sample, color = Sample))+
  geom_point()


#N50 & read depth
pycoQC<- Sys.glob("output/*/QC/*pycoQC_output.html") %>%
  map_dfr(~ as.data.frame(fread(cmd = paste0("grep 'N50' ", .x), sep = "?", header=F)[[1L]][[2]]) %>%
            mutate(Sample = gsub("_pycoQC_output.html", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  dplyr::rename(lines = 1) 

lines = lapply(pycoQC$lines, function(x) unlist(strsplit(unlist(strsplit(x, ":"))[[10]], ", ")))
pycoQC$N50_upper <- unlist(lapply(lines, function(x) as.numeric(gsub("\\[","",x[9]))))
pycoQC$N50_lower <- unlist(lapply(lines, function(x) as.numeric(gsub("\\]","",x[10]))))
pycoQC$read_depth_upper <- unlist(lapply(lines, function(x) as.numeric(gsub("\\[","",x[7]))))
pycoQC$read_depth_lower <- unlist(lapply(lines, function(x) as.numeric(gsub("\\]","",x[8]))))

pycoQC <-pycoQC %>%
  dplyr::select(-lines) %>%
  mutate(N50 = (N50_upper+N50_lower)/2,
         read_depth = (read_depth_lower + read_depth_upper)/2) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, N50, read_depth)

write.table(pycoQC, "plots/N50_RD.tsv", quote = F, row.names = F, sep = "\t")
```

# load methylation

```{r}
lr_all_sample <- Sys.glob("output/*/Me/*_pileup_tab.bed") %>%
  map_dfr( ~ fread(.) %>%
             `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "start", "end", "mod_type", "Nvalid_cov_2", "strand", "start_2", "end_2", "color_2", "Nvalid_cov", "fraction_mod", "Nmod", "Ncanonical", "Nother_mod", "Ndelete", "Nfail", "Ndiff", "Nnocall")) %>%
             dplyr::select(-contains("_2")) %>%
             mutate(Sample = gsub("_pileup_tab.bed", "", basename(.x))))  %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, level = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))


lr_5mc <- lr_all_sample %>%
  filter(mod_type == "m")


lr_5hmc <- lr_all_sample %>%
  filter(mod_type == "h")

rm(lr_all_sample)
sample_list <- unique(lr_5mc$Sample)
```

```{r}
#5mc
lr_5mc_wide <- lr_5mc %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, chrom, start, fraction_mod) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Sample", values_from = "fraction_mod")

#5hmc
lr_5hmc_wide <- lr_5hmc %>%
   mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, level = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, chrom, start, fraction_mod) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Sample", values_from = "fraction_mod")

```

## filtration

if the absence sites are SNP

```{r}
lr_5mc_missing <- lr_5mc_wide[!complete.cases(lr_5mc_wide),]

#consider all the possibility of altered CpG then construct a bed file 
lr_5mc_missing %>%
  mutate(pos_1 = start -1, pos_2 = start +1) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, pos_1, pos_2) %>%
  write.table(., "output/mod_missing.bed", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F, sep = "\t")
```

```{bash}
module load bedtools/2.29.0
intersectBed -a /reference/dbsnp/150_hg38/All_20170710.vcf -b mod_missing.bed -header > mod_snp.vcf
```

## position specific

### TSS

```{r}
TSS <- fread("ref/biomaRT_TSS_hg38_20MAR2024.txt") %>%
  filter(`Chromosome/scaffold name` %in% as.character(seq(0,22)),
         `RefSeq match transcript (MANE Select)` !="")%>%
  dplyr::select(chrom =`Chromosome/scaffold name`, TSS = `Transcription start site (TSS)`, Gene_name = `Gene name` ) %>%
  mutate(chrom = paste0("chr", chrom),
         TSS_start = TSS- 10000, TSS_end = TSS+ 10000)


TSS_annotation <- na.omit(TSS %>%
  left_join(lr_5mc_filt, by = join_by(chrom==chrom, TSS_start <= start, TSS_end >= start)))

TSS_annotation %>%
  mutate(distance = start - TSS,
         bin = round(distance/100)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "methylation") %>%
  group_by(Sample, bin) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(methylation)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin /10, y = mean, color = Sample))+
  geom_line()+
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_line_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Relative to TSS (kb)")+
  ylab("Average Methylation %")+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
         
ggsave("plots/Me/TSS_line.pdf", width = 10, height = 7)

# 
# library(scattermore)
# TSS_annotation %>%
#   pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "methylation") %>%
#   mutate(pos = start -TSS) %>%
#   group_by(Sample) %>%
#   group_map( ~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = pos, y = methylation))+
#   geom_scattermore(alpha = 0.1))
  


TSS_plots <- TSS_annotation %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "methylation") %>%
  mutate(pos = (start -TSS)/1000) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  group_map( ~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = pos, y = methylation))+
               geom_bin2d(bins = 70) +
  scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis",
                        trans = scales::log10_trans(), breaks = 10^seq(0,6), labels = 10^seq(0,6)) +
  xlab("Relative to TSS (kb)")+
  theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
    ggtitle(unique(.y)))

ggarrange(plotlist = TSS_plots, nrow = 3, ncol = 2)

ggsave("plots/Me/TSS_individual_profile.pdf", height = 16, width = 10)
```

### island shore shelf

```{r}
ucsc_island_annot <- fread("ref/cpg_islands_ucsc.bed") 

CpG_annot <- ucsc_island_annot %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart,chromEnd, name) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, levels = paste0("chr", seq(0, 22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))


lr_5mc_island <- lr_5mc_filt %>%
  left_join(CpG_annot %>%
              mutate(chromStart_ext = chromStart-4000,
                     chromEnd_ext = chromEnd+4000,), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, start >= chromStart_ext, start <= chromEnd_ext))


island_coverage <- lr_5mc_island %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  filter(start >= chromStart, start <= chromEnd) %>%
  group_by(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name) %>%
  summarise(n= n()) %>%
  left_join(ucsc_island_annot %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name, cpgNum))

# cross check the number I have and the number has been annotated by the ucsc track
island_coverage %>%
  mutate(proportion = n/cpgNum) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chrom, y = proportion))+
  geom_boxplot()


lr_5mc_island %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  mutate(island_bin_size = (chromEnd-chromStart)/10,
         bin = case_when(start < chromStart ~ floor((start- chromStart+4000)/200),
                         start >=chromStart & start <chromEnd ~ floor((start-chromStart)/island_bin_size)+20,
                         start >= chromEnd ~ floor((start -chromEnd)/200) + 30)) %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(OVCAR8_LP_A6_30 = mean(OVCAR8_LP_A6_30),
            OVCAR8 = mean(OVCAR8),
            UWB1_BRCA1 = mean(UWB1_BRCA1),
            UWB1 = mean(UWB1),
            WEHI_CS62 = mean(WEHI_CS62)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Methylation") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin, y = Methylation, color = Sample, group = Sample)) +
  geom_line()+
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_line_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  ggtitle("all CpG island")
  
ggsave("plots/Me/CpG_island_all_binned.pdf")


mat <- lr_5mc_island %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  mutate(island_bin_size = (chromEnd-chromStart),
         bin = case_when(start < chromStart ~ (start- chromStart),
                         start >=chromStart & start <chromEnd ~ (start-chromStart)/island_bin_size*2000,
                         start >= chromEnd ~ (start -chromEnd) + 2000),
         name = paste(chrom, chromStart, sep = "_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list),values_to = "Methylation", names_to = "Sample") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  group_map(~ ggplot(., aes(x = bin, y = name, color = Methylation)) +
                       geom_scattermore(pointsize = 0)+
              theme_bw()+
              theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank())+
              scale_color_distiller(palette= "YlOrBr", direction = 1)+
              ylab("CpG Island")+
              scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4000, -2000, 0, 2000, 4000, 6000), 
                                 labels = c("-4000", "-2000", "left", "right", "2000", "4000"))+
              ggtitle(unique(.y)))

pdf("plots/Me/CpG_island_binned_all_sites.pdf", height = 15, width = 17)
ggarrange(plotlist = mat, nrow = 1, common.legend = T ,legend = "bottom")
dev.off()
```

### island shore shelf boxplot

```{r}
lr_5mc_island_boxplot <- lr_5mc_island %>%
  mutate(location = case_when(
    is.na(name) ~ "Open_Sea",
    start < chromStart & (chromStart - start) < 2000 ~ "N_Shore",
        start < chromStart & (chromStart - start) <=4000 ~ "N_Shelf",
        start > chromEnd & (start - chromEnd) < 2000 ~ "S_Shore",
         start > chromEnd & (start - chromEnd) <= 4000 ~ "S_Shelf",
        TRUE ~ "Island"),
        location = factor(location ,levels = c("N_Shelf", "N_Shore", "Island", "S_Shore", "S_Shelf", "Open_Sea"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Methylation") 

island.stat <- lr_5mc_island_boxplot %>%
  group_by(location, .keep =T) %>%
  group_map(~ kruskal.test(Methylation ~ Sample, data =.))

island.stat.paired <- lr_5mc_island_boxplot %>%
  group_by(location, .keep = T) %>%
  group_map(~ pairwise.wilcox.test(.x$Methylation, .x$Sample, p.adjust.method = "BH"))

island.stat.paired.df <- bind_rows(lapply(island.stat.paired, function(x) as.data.frame((x$p.value)) %>%
         rownames_to_column("group1"))) %>%
  mutate(location = unlist(lapply(c("N_Shelf", "N_Shore", "Island", "S_Shore", "S_Shelf", "Open_Sea"), function(x) rep(x, 4)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1"), names_to = "group2", values_to = "p.adj")%>%
  filter(!is.na(p.adj)) %>%
  mutate(`.y.` = "Methylation",
         y.position = rep(seq(105, 150, 5), 6),
         p.sig = case_when(p.adj > 0.05 ~ "ns",
            p.adj > 0.01 ~ "*",
            p.adj > 0.001 ~ "**",
            !is.na(p.adj) ~ "***"),
         location = factor(location ,levels = c("N_Shelf", "N_Shore", "Island", "S_Shore", "S_Shelf", "Open_Sea")))

plots <- lr_5mc_island_boxplot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = Methylation, color = Sample))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(location))+
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_line_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))
ggsave("plots/Me/CpG_island_location_boxplot.pdf", width =12, height = 7)

violin <- lr_5mc_island_boxplot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = Methylation))+
  geom_violin(aes(color = Sample))+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(location))+
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_line_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))+
  stat_pvalue_manual(island.stat.paired.df, label = "p.sig", tip.length = 0,size = 2)
ggsave(plot = violin, "plots/Me/CpG_island_location_violinplot.pdf", width =15, height = 7)

```

### promoter overlapped island

```{r}
#TSS intersected
promoter <- fread("ref/human_epdnew_eu9NP.bed") %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "promoterStart", "promoterEnd", "promoterName", "score", "strand"))

promoter_annotation <-CpG_annot %>%
  left_join(promoter, by =join_by(chrom == chrom, chromStart <=promoterStart, chromEnd >= promoterEnd) )%>%
  group_by(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name) %>%
  summarise(promoter_overlap = sum(!is.na(promoterName))>0)

lr_island %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  left_join(promoter_annotation) %>%
  mutate(promoter_overlap = paste0("Promoter Overlapped:", promoter_overlap)) %>%
  mutate(island_bin_size = (chromEnd-chromStart)/10,
         bin = case_when(start < chromStart ~ floor((start- chromStart+4000)/200),
                         start >=chromStart & start <chromEnd ~ floor((start-chromStart)/island_bin_size)+20,
                         start >= chromEnd ~ floor((start -chromEnd)/200) + 30)) %>%
  group_by(bin, promoter_overlap) %>%
  summarise(OVCAR8_LP_A6_30 = mean(OVCAR8_LP_A6_30),
            OVCAR8 = mean(OVCAR8),
            UWB1_BRCA1 = mean(UWB1_BRCA1),
            UWB1 = mean(UWB1),
            WEHI_CS62 = mean(WEHI_CS62)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Methylation") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin, y = Methylation, color = Sample, group = Sample)) +
  geom_line()+
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_line_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  facet_wrap(~promoter_overlap, nrow =2)
ggsave("plots/Me/CpG_island_promoter.pdf", height =6, width =4)



# raster plot
lr_island_plots <- lr_island %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  left_join(promoter_annotation) %>%
  mutate(promoter_overlap = paste0("Promoter Overlapped:", promoter_overlap)) %>%
  mutate(island_bin_size = (chromEnd-chromStart),
         bin = case_when(start < chromStart ~ start- chromStart+4000,
                         start >=chromStart & start <chromEnd ~ (start-chromStart)/island_bin_size*2000+4000,
                         start >= chromEnd ~ (start -chromEnd)+ 6000)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "methylation")  %>%
  group_by(Sample, promoter_overlap) %>%
  group_map( ~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = bin, y = methylation))+
               geom_bin2d(bins = 70) +
  scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis",
                        trans = scales::log10_trans(), breaks = 10^seq(0,5), labels = 10^seq(0,5)) +
  xlab("bin")+
  theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.position = "none")+
    ggtitle(unique(paste0(.y$Sample, "_", .y$promoter_overlap))))

ggarrange(plotlist = lr_island_plots, nrow =5, ncol = 2)
ggsave("plots/Me/CpG_island_promoter_breakdown_raster.pdf", height = 24, width = 10)
```

# whole genome methylation association across sample

```{r}
meth_mat <- na.omit(lr_5mc_filt %>%
                      mutate(sitename=paste(chrom,start, sep = "_")) %>%
                      column_to_rownames("sitename") %>%
                      dplyr::select(-chrom, -start))
sds=rowSds(as.matrix(meth_mat)/100)
sds_col = colSds(as.matrix(meth_mat)/100)
meth_mat = meth_mat[sds>0.25,sds_col>0]
pcr <- prcomp(t(meth_mat), scale.= F, center =T)


library(factoextra)
fviz_eig(pcr)

fviz_pca_ind(pcr, repel =T, habillage = colnames(meth_mat), palette = unlist(cell_line_palette), axes.linetype=NA)+
  theme(legend.position = "none") 
ggsave("plots/QC/pca.pdf", height = 6, width = 6)

corr_matrix <-cor(na.omit(lr_5mc_filt  %>%
  dplyr::select(-chrom, -start)))
pdf("plots/QC/corr_all_cpg_post_filt.pdf")
corrplot(corr_matrix,method = "color", order = "alphabet", addCoef.col = "black")
dev.off()

corr_matrix <-cor(meth_mat)
pdf("plots/QC/corr_all_cpg_sd_0.25.pdf")
corrplot(corr_matrix,method = "color", order = "alphabet", addCoef.col = "black")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
single_base_matched_dmr <- fread("output/dmr_pb/single_base_matched_dmr.bed") %>%
```

# overview of methylation landscape 5hmC

##TSS

```{r}
TSS <- fread("ref/biomaRT_TSS_hg38_20MAR2024.txt") %>%
  filter(`Chromosome/scaffold name` %in% as.character(seq(0,22)),
         `RefSeq match transcript (MANE Select)` !="")%>%
  dplyr::select(chrom =`Chromosome/scaffold name`, TSS = `Transcription start site (TSS)`, Gene_name = `Gene name` ) %>%
  mutate(chrom = paste0("chr", chrom),
         TSS_start = TSS- 10000, TSS_end = TSS+ 10000)


TSS_annotation <- na.omit(TSS %>%
  left_join(lr_5hmc_filt, by = join_by(chrom==chrom, TSS_start <= start, TSS_end >= start)))

TSS_annotation %>%
  mutate(distance = start - TSS,
         bin = round(distance/100)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "methylation") %>%
  group_by(Sample, bin) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(methylation)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin /10, y = mean, color = Sample))+
  geom_line()+
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_line_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Relative to TSS (kb)")+
  ylab("Average Methylation %")+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
         
ggsave("plots/Me/TSS_line_5hmc.pdf", width = 10, height = 7)


library(scattermore)
TSS_annotation %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "methylation") %>%
  mutate(pos = start -TSS) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  group_map( ~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = pos, y = methylation))+
  geom_scattermore(alpha = 0.1))
  


TSS_plots <- TSS_annotation %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "methylation") %>%
  mutate(pos = (start -TSS)/1000) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  group_map( ~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = pos, y = methylation))+
               geom_bin2d(bins = 70) +
  scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis",
                        trans = scales::log10_trans(), breaks = 10^seq(0,5), labels = 10^seq(0,5)) +
  ylim(c(0,100))+
  xlab("Relative to TSS (kb)")+
  theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
    ggtitle(unique(.y)))

ggarrange(plotlist = TSS_plots, nrow = 3, ncol = 2)

ggsave("plots/Me/TSS_individual_profile_5hmc.pdf", height = 16, width = 10)
```

### island shore shelf

```{r}
ucsc_island_annot <- fread("ref/cpg_islands_ucsc.bed") 

CpG_annot <- ucsc_island_annot %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart,chromEnd, name) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, levels = paste0("chr", seq(0, 22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))


lr_5hmc_island <- lr_5hmc_filt %>%
  left_join(CpG_annot %>%
              mutate(chromStart_ext = chromStart-4000,
                     chromEnd_ext = chromEnd+4000,), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, start >= chromStart_ext, start <= chromEnd_ext))


island_coverage <- lr_5hmc_island %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  filter(start >= chromStart, start <= chromEnd) %>%
  group_by(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name) %>%
  summarise(n= n()) %>%
  left_join(ucsc_island_annot %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name, cpgNum))


lr_5hmc_island %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  mutate(island_bin_size = (chromEnd-chromStart)/10,
         bin = case_when(start < chromStart ~ floor((start- chromStart+4000)/200),
                         start >=chromStart & start <chromEnd ~ floor((start-chromStart)/island_bin_size)+20,
                         start >= chromEnd ~ floor((start -chromEnd)/200) + 30)) %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(OVCAR8_LP_A6_30 = mean(OVCAR8_LP_A6_30),
            OVCAR8 = mean(OVCAR8),
            UWB1_BRCA1 = mean(UWB1_BRCA1),
            UWB1 = mean(UWB1),
            WEHI_CS62 = mean(WEHI_CS62)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Methylation") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin, y = Methylation, color = Sample, group = Sample)) +
  geom_line()+
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_line_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  ggtitle("all CpG island")
  
ggsave("plots/Me/CpG_island_all_binned_5hmc.pdf")


mat <- lr_5hmc_island %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  mutate(island_bin_size = (chromEnd-chromStart),
         bin = case_when(start < chromStart ~ (start- chromStart),
                         start >=chromStart & start <chromEnd ~ (start-chromStart)/island_bin_size*2000,
                         start >= chromEnd ~ (start -chromEnd) + 2000),
         name = paste(chrom, chromStart, sep = "_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list),values_to = "Methylation", names_to = "Sample") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  group_map(~ ggplot(., aes(x = bin, y = name, color = Methylation)) +
                       geom_scattermore(pointsize = 0)+
              theme_bw()+
              theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank())+
              scale_color_distiller(palette= "YlOrBr", direction = 1, limits = c(0, 5))+
              ylab("CpG Island")+
              scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-4000, -2000, 0, 2000, 4000, 6000), 
                                 labels = c("-4000", "-2000", "left", "right", "2000", "4000"))+
              ggtitle(unique(.y)))

pdf("plots/Me/CpG_island_binned_all_sites_5hmc.pdf", height = 15, width = 17)
ggarrange(plotlist = mat, nrow = 1, common.legend = T ,legend = "bottom")
dev.off()
```

### promoter overlapped island

```{r}
#TSS intersected
promoter <- fread("ref/human_epdnew_eu9NP.bed") %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "promoterStart", "promoterEnd", "promoterName", "score", "strand"))

promoter_annotation <-CpG_annot %>%
  left_join(promoter, by =join_by(chrom == chrom, chromStart <=promoterStart, chromEnd >= promoterEnd) )%>%
  group_by(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name) %>%
  summarise(promoter_overlap = sum(!is.na(promoterName))>0)

lr_5hmc_island %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  left_join(promoter_annotation) %>%
  mutate(promoter_overlap = paste0("Promoter Overlapped:", promoter_overlap)) %>%
  mutate(island_bin_size = (chromEnd-chromStart)/10,
         bin = case_when(start < chromStart ~ floor((start- chromStart+4000)/200),
                         start >=chromStart & start <chromEnd ~ floor((start-chromStart)/island_bin_size)+20,
                         start >= chromEnd ~ floor((start -chromEnd)/200) + 30)) %>%
  group_by(bin, promoter_overlap) %>%
  summarise(OVCAR8_LP_A6_30 = mean(OVCAR8_LP_A6_30),
            OVCAR8 = mean(OVCAR8),
            UWB1_BRCA1 = mean(UWB1_BRCA1),
            UWB1 = mean(UWB1),
            WEHI_CS62 = mean(WEHI_CS62)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_list), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Methylation") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bin, y = Methylation, color = Sample, group = Sample)) +
  geom_line()+
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_line_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  facet_wrap(~promoter_overlap, nrow =2)
ggsave("plots/Me/CpG_island_promoter_5hmc.pdf", height = 24, width = 10)
```

#Modkit multi DMR

```{r}
multi_dmr <- Sys.glob("output/dmr/*.bed") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x) %>%
            mutate(comparison = gsub(".bed", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "start", "end", "name","score", "sample_a_count", "sample_a_total", "sample_b_count", "sample_b_total", "sample_a_fraction", "sample_b_fraction", "comparison")) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, levels = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom), sample_b_total != 0, sample_a_total != 0 )%>%
   mutate(name= paste(chrom, start,name, sep = "_")) %>%
  separate(sample_a_fraction, into = c("a5hmc", "a5mc"), sep = ",") %>%
  separate(sample_b_fraction, into = c("b5hmc", "b5mc"), sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(a5mc = as.numeric(gsub("m:", "", a5mc)),
         b5mc = as.numeric(gsub("m:", "", b5mc)),
         abs_diff = abs(a5mc - b5mc))

multi_dmr  %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = abs_diff, y = score))+
  geom_scattermore()+
  facet_wrap(~comparison)+
  scale_y_log10()
ggsave("plots/Me/modkit_island_diff.pdf", width = 12, height = 6)

```

### attempt to subset island different in isogenic pair

```{r}
iso_diff_ovcar8 <- multi_dmr %>%
  filter(comparison == "OVCAR8_OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", abs_diff >= 25) %>%
  pull(name) %>%
  unique()


iso_diff_uwb1 <- multi_dmr %>%
  filter(comparison == "UWB1_UWB1_BRCA1", abs_diff >= 25) %>%
  pull(name) %>%
  unique()

library(ggvenn)
ggvenn(list(ovcar8_diff = iso_diff_ovcar8, uwb1_diff= iso_diff_uwb1))


mat <- multi_dmr %>%
  dplyr::select(name,chrom, start, end, score,  a5mc, b5mc, comparison) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("a5mc", "b5mc"), names_to = "name1", values_to = "5mc") %>%
  mutate(a5mc = case_when(startsWith(comparison, "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30_") ~"OVCAR8_LP_A6_30",
                          startsWith(comparison, "OVCAR8_") ~"OVCAR8",
                          startsWith(comparison, "UWB1_BRCA1_") ~"UWB1_BRCA1",
                          startsWith(comparison, "UWB1_") ~"UWB1"),
         b5mc = case_when(endsWith(comparison, "_UWB1") ~"UWB1",
                          endsWith(comparison, "_UWB1_BRCA1") ~"UWB1_BRCA1",
                          endsWith(comparison, "_WEHI_CS62") ~"WEHI_CS62",
                          endsWith(comparison, "_OVCAR8_LP_A6_30") ~"OVCAR8_LP_A6_30")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols =c("a5mc", "b5mc"), names_to = "name2", values_to = "Sample" ) %>%
  filter(name1 == name2) %>%
  dplyr::select(name, `5mc`, Sample)%>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Sample", values_from = "5mc") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  column_to_rownames("name")

Heatmap(mat[iso_diff_ovcar8,], show_row_names = F, cluster_columns = F,
        column_order = c("OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62"))

        column_order = c("OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62"))

Heatmap(mat[intersect(iso_diff_uwb1, iso_diff_ovcar8),], show_row_names = F, cluster_columns = F,
        column_order = c("OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62"))
```
